styles.css: list-style: none; & li { padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--30) 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--wp--preset--color--rule); line-height: 1; opacity: 1; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } & li:last-child { border-bottom: none; } & li:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0.9; } & li:nth-child(3) { opacity: 0.8; } & li:nth-child(4) { opacity: 0.7; } & li:nth-child(5) { opacity: 0.6; } & li:nth-child(n+6) { opacity: 0.5; } & li:nth-child(n+7) { opacity: 0.4; } & li:nth-child(n+8) { opacity: 0.3; }
